name: mirage
text: Understood: when the GitHub engine drives, toggles on the phone are settings for the engine, and the phone opens no sockets of its own unless you switch GitHub off. I'm auditing every phone socket, auto-bet and bid path against that rule now and will fix any that still run on the phone. I'll report what I found. I'll touch only phone-side gating, not the engine, and check the board first.
